dialogues.speaker: Shizhuang the Strong
dialogues.text: Ever since they closed the Chasm, I've been patrolling this area. Mostly to stop people breaking the rules and trying to get inside...

dialogues.speaker: Shizhuang the Strong
dialogues.text: I've noticed some sizable Crystal Ore deposits while on patrol. Shame they're no use to me, they aren't the ores I'm looking for.

dialogues.speaker: Shizhuang the Strong
dialogues.text: You're interested? Alright, I think they were...

dialogues.speaker: Shizhuang the Strong
dialogues.text: ...Here. Marked on your map. Feel free to explore, just keep away from the Chasm.
